## What I do (hire intent)

- **DTC growth & paid social.** Meta/TikTok/Google ads operator with end-to-end Shopify experience — product testing, creative iteration, supplier coordination, retention.
- **AI systems for growth teams.** Building production-grade agents on the Glitch Executor Labs stack (LangGraph, MCP, voice). Same operator who runs the campaigns also owns the automation.
- **Performance marketing for SaaS + ecom.** Worked inside Quickads (performance shop) on brands including Udemy and Night Habit.
- **Content + SEO.** Eight-year history including renewable-energy/EV content authority at CableCommunity; daily-cadence content systems.

## Hiring signals

Best fit for roles where one operator owns BOTH the growth motion AND the systems underneath it — DTC brands, AI-first agencies, growth-tooling startups. Less fit for: very narrow specialist seats (single-channel media buyer, pure ad-ops).
